info.name: OpenWeather and Air Pollution One Call API
Current and forecast weather data for a coordinate

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, range -90 to 90.

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, range -180 to 180.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Comma-separated list of forecast blocks to omit from the response. Allowed values are current, minutely, hourly, daily, and alerts.

params.name: units
params.description: Units of measurement. One of standard, metric, or imperial. Default is standard (Kelvin, m/s).

params.name: lang
params.description: ISO language code for localized response text.

items.docs: Returns current weather, minute-by-minute forecast for one hour, hourly forecast for 48 hours, daily forecast for 8 days, and any government weather alerts for the supplied latitude and longitude.

info.name: Historical weather data for a coordinate and timestamp

params.name: dt
params.description: Unix UTC timestamp for the requested historical reading.

items.docs: Returns historical weather data for the supplied latitude, longitude, and Unix UTC timestamp. Data depth depends on the subscription plan.
